_comment: Idea groups, Paradox style. A country takes up groups into its idea slots (one at the start, one more for every eight technologies known) and buys their ideas in order with idea points, a share of its research points. Modifiers use the keys of laws and techs, plus stability_cost, aggression, siege and trade_income.

groups.name: Administrative Ideas
groups.description: The arts of ruling: records, officials, roads and the measured field.

ideas.name: Royal Granaries
ideas.description: Stores against the lean years keep the people quiet and the tax flowing.

ideas.name: Provincial Governors
ideas.description: Nomarchs and governors answerable to the crown.

ideas.name: Scribal Schools
ideas.description: Boys taught to read and reckon in the king's service.

ideas.name: The Measured Field
ideas.description: Every field surveyed and its yield known.

ideas.name: Royal Messengers
ideas.description: Runners and way stations carry the king's word.

ideas.name: Standing Orders

ideas.name: Census of Souls

ideas.name: Thirst for Glory

ideas.name: Fortress Towns

ideas.name: The Nation under Arms
